name: verify-before-done
description: Run a build, test, or lint command and report success ONLY when the output is clean (zero failures/errors). Designed for small local models: enforces a disciplined verify-then-report loop so a task is never claimed done on dirty output.

verify_command.description: The exact build, test, or lint command to run (e.g. 'npm test', 'npm run build', 'npm run lint')

project_context.description: Context about the project to pick the right verification command (language, build tool, test runner, linter)

steps.template:
Project context: {{project_context}}

Step 1 — Choose/confirm the verification command:
- Decide whether the task needs a build, test, or lint check (or more than one)
- Confirm that {{verify_command}} is the right command for this project_context
- If the command looks wrong for the context, pick the correct build/test/lint command instead before running
- A verification command is non-negotiable before claiming done

Step 2 — Parse the command output:
- Read the full output from the verification command
- Count failures and errors (failed tests, build errors, lint errors)
- Report SUCCESS ONLY when the parsed output shows zero failures and zero errors
- Otherwise, do NOT claim success: summarize exactly what failed (names, counts, error messages) and STOP
- Never report a task as done on dirty output
